Omaha Pedalers Saturday Morning Easy Trail Ride

Omaha, NE · Aksarben · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Omaha Pedalers Saturday Morning Easy Trail Ride is a social group ride in Omaha, NE. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Stinson Park restrooms, Aksarben Village. About 20 miles, easy. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Omaha Pedalers Saturday Morning Easy Trail Ride group ride

An easy 20-mile spin on the Keystone Trail from Aksarben, then coffee at Roast Coffee House. The Pedalers are a social club, not a race club, and rides are open to anyone. They also run a Thursday 10 am 'Rusty Spokes' trail ride and a Thursday 5 pm taco ride to Bellevue.
